impact: Memory weakness keeps pressure on MU, DRAM and SNXX into Nvidia's results tonight; a strong Nvidia guide is the main catalyst for a rebound.
summary: Seoul's Kospi opened Tuesday at 5,008.09, down 1.81%, then slipped below 5,000 for the first time in six sessions after Wall Street's chip selloff. Samsung Electronics traded near 191,000 won (down about 3%) and SK Hynix fell 1.6% to 1.102 million won, extending Monday's 4.5% and 7.9% drops.
title: Kospi opens down 1.8%, slips below 5,000 on Nvidia day
